translations.web: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.
translations.bsb: Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain.
translations.kjv: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
translations.asv: Behold, I will press you in your place, as a cart presseth that is full of sheaves.
